usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Ghost publishes about them through “Update Post” and “Create Newsletter”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Update Post” in Ghost
bestTemplate.why: Launch posts go stale, so a new product can refresh an existing post instead of starting a new one.

watchOut: “Update Post” edits an existing post, so every run needs the right post chosen or it changes the wrong one.
